title: Excuse Me, Where Is the Library?

sents.t: On Sunday, I want to find the Oakville Library.
I want to read books in English.
I have a map on my phone, but my phone has no battery.
I stop a woman on the street.
“Go straight on Main Street. Turn left at the bank. Then walk two blocks. The library is on the right, across from the post office. It is a big white building between a school and a small park.”
“Straight, left at the bank, two blocks, on the right. Thank you!”
I walk straight and turn left at the bank.
After two blocks, I see the post office on the left and a big white building on the right.
I fill out a form, and in five minutes, I have a library card.
Today I take home three books and two movies.
Next time, I can walk here without a map.

comp.q: What does Sam want to find?
comp.fa: سام می‌خواهد کجا را پیدا کند؟

comp.q: Why can’t Sam use the map on his phone?
comp.fa: چرا سام نمی‌تواند از نقشه‌ی گوشی‌اش استفاده کند؟

comp.q: What is across from the library?
What is the library building like?

comp.fa: سام چه چیزهایی به خانه می‌برد؟
